name: Komine Sachi
source:
Sachi is often seen with her idol friend Michiru. After all, she's working as her maid! She's peaceful and serious, but sometimes, she doesn't get jokes straight away. She also has quite a sharp tongue at times. However, she is a friend when it counts... most of the time.
